name: jv_excel_writer
description: Create and verify an XLSX workbook with tables, permitted formulas and bar/line charts. Use provided data; unknown figures remain blank.

request.description: Workbook brief and supplied source data, if not using a structured specification.

filename.description: New workbook filename; existing files are never overwritten.

workbook.description: Structured {sheets:[{name, columns:[...], rows:[[...]], chart:{type:bar|line,title}}]}. Formula cells are {formula:'=SUM(B2:B8)'}. Charts are optional.
